name: Ahab
summary: A king of Israel who reigned in Samaria and did more evil in the sight of the LORD than all the kings before him. He married Jezebel, served Baal, and stood against the prophet Elijah.

key_moments.title: Marries Jezebel and Serves Baal
key_moments.description: Ahab became king over Israel and ruled from Samaria for twenty-two years, doing more evil than any king before him. He married Jezebel, worshiped Baal and built an altar for Baal in Samaria.

key_moments.title: Gathers Israel to Mount Carmel
key_moments.description: Ahab called Elijah the one who troubled Israel, but Elijah said Ahab had troubled Israel by following Baal. At Elijah's word Ahab gathered all Israel and the prophets of Baal to Mount Carmel.

key_moments.title: Racing the Rain
key_moments.description: After the long drought, Elijah told Ahab to eat and drink, for rain was coming. As the sky grew black with clouds, Ahab rode to Jezreel, and Elijah ran ahead of him.

key_moments.title: Takes Naboth's Vineyard
key_moments.description: Naboth would not sell Ahab his vineyard, so Jezebel had Naboth falsely accused and stoned. When Ahab went to take the vineyard, Elijah met him with the LORD's word of judgment on him and his house.

key_moments.title: Killed by an Arrow at Ramoth-gilead
key_moments.description: Ahab went into battle at Ramoth-gilead in disguise, but a man drew a bow at random and struck him. He died that evening and was buried in Samaria.
